text:
riya: Quick sync post-RFC. I sketched a low-risk plan to break out tenant-routing + enrichment into a small routing-worker. Goal: reversible cutover, clear data ownership, and low-latency parity checks. PTAL.
omar: looks sensible. main Q: will the new service ever write to the primary DB during rollout? ownership dictates migration steps.
jon: proposal: read-only for first 72h (parity + perf), then allow idempotent telemetry writes, final flip after parity threshold met. keeps audit trail intact.
pat: telemetry & traces are must-haves. I need per-route histograms + 100% traces during canary. also add a golden-requests set for automated parity checks.
sylvia: infra note: need canary LB rule and certs; I'll request a separate cert chain. also suggest per-tenant concurrency caps to avoid hot-tenant spikes.
riya: checklist (reversible steps):
- infra prep: VPC, canary LB rule, certs
- deploy routing-worker in shadow mirror mode
- run parity job (24-72h), mismatch threshold 0.2%
- 1% read-only canary + perf gates (p95 <= baseline, error delta <= 0.5%)
- warm cache + staged telemetry writes (idempotent only)
- progressive ramp to 100% with observability gates
- flip DB write ownership and retire shadow proxies
- rollback: remove LB rule, route back to monolith, keep monolith writes until explicit flip
jon: add DB replication sanity check (`wal_level` + lag alert) and schema compatibility smoke tests.
pat: will wire OTEL dashboards and golden set checks. sylvia: I'll handle certs and LB rule. omar: I'll own contract tests.
sylvia: infra-bot: canary LB rule scheduled -> route-rule-401 @ 2025-08-07T02:00Z
riya: owners assigned: infra->sylvia, telemetry->pat, contracts->omar, rollout->riya. please ack with :thumbsup:.
omar: :thumbsup:
pat: :thumbsup:
sylvia: :thumbsup:
riya: adding a post-cutover retro slot to capture error-budget burn and cache behavior. if anyone spots an unresolved dependency drop it here.
jon: one more risk callout: cross-tenant enrichment may increase memory usage; add a soft-memory limit and circuit-breaker.
pat: will add metric names: `routing.p95_ms`, `routing.parity_mismatch`, `routing.concurrent_per_tenant`, `routing.reject_count`.
riya: perfect. staging rehearse tomorrow, nightly canaries Thu-Sat, weekend final flip. closing here unless new deps appear.
